name: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Mobile
summary: Battle through waves of enemies and save the multiverse! Enter a pulse-pounding world of pixel-powered chaos with Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Mobile, the definitive mobile remaster of the beloved anime-style beat 'em up. Step into the shoes of Mikoto, Waka, Itsuki, and Yuzuha – a quartet of fierce warriors fighting through the streets of Tokyo to rescue a kidnapped friend and stop an interdimensional threat.
